Kageaki(Can you move at once?)
Muramasa《Yes. I am no longer shut in. And what is this? Apparently I need not bite to death the woman who had me stuffed in that hateful box until a moment ago?》

Kageaki(Good. You can get here?)

Rather far to slip past the soldiers’ eyes. But for the Muramasa, versed in concealment—

en.html:
There was no time to trade further idle remarks. I could already hear dozens of footsteps converging upon this room.

If I wished to remain ignorant of the fate of a prisoner whose escape attempt failed, I had to act without wasting an instant.

ja.html:
重ねて無駄口を叩く余裕はなかった。
　この部屋に向かって殺到する、数十人規模の足音を
既に耳孔は捉えている。

　脱走を試みて失敗した捕虜の運命なるものについて
無知でいるためには、寸暇を惜しんで動くしかない。
